test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A contractor agrees to complete a building in 120 days. He employs 75 workers. After 80 days, only half of the work is completed. To avoid the penalty and finish the remaining work on time. How many additional worker must be employ?
solution:
**Given:**

Total time = 120 days

Initial workers = 75

Work done in 80 days = 1/2

Remaining work = 1/2

Remaining time = 40 days

**Formula Used:**

Work ∝ Workers × Time

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work done = 75 × 80 = 6000 (for 1/2 work)

⇒ Total work = 6000 × 2 = 12000

⇒ Remaining work = 12000 ÷ 2 = 6000

⇒ Required workers × 40 = 6000

⇒ Required workers = 6000 ÷ 40 = 150

⇒ Additional workers = 150 − 75 = 75

**∴ The correct answer is 75.**
